verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a data-infrastructure/CDP tool for collecting and routing customer event data to warehouses/destinations, not an AI model or AI assistant that trains on user data — the story asks about preventing AI-model-training use of data, which is a wrong-axis question for this product category. Nothing in the evidence pack relates to AI training opt-out; self-hosting and filtering functions address data routing/control, not AI training exclusion.
